description: Ministry of Sports - Order to amend the Sports Act, adding "62. Scrabble'' to the Schedule II
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Sports Act (No. 25 of 1973) by the Minister of Sports, adding Scrabble to Schedule II of the Order. It represents a regulatory amendment to existing legislation, specifically modifying the legal framework governing recognized sports. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and modifications to existing regulations rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
